content.text:
Reviewed [trail 165 / PR #213](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/pull/213) at `f3cb890e`. **Three findings; I recommend changes.**

1. **[P2] Deduplication discards results from later copies.** At [stats.go:649](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/blob/f3cb890e6d426d3bd3800f7c30b7ca9a98d08621/internal/cli/stats.go#L649), an already-seen call is skipped even when its first copy lacked a result. A reproduction with an incomplete transcript followed by a complete replay reports **0 result bytes instead of 13**. Merge result completeness while counting the call once.

2. **[P2] Partial replays overwrite complete token usage.** At [stats.go:675](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/blob/f3cb890e6d426d3bd3800f7c30b7ca9a98d08621/internal/cli/stats.go#L675), the lexicographically last transcript wins regardless of completeness. A complete message with 50 output tokens followed by a partial replay reports **5**, distorting billed totals and savings percentages. Preserve the complete usage record independently of filename order.

3. **[P2] Cache loading skips gzip integrity validation.** At [stats_cache.go:124](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/blob/f3cb890e6d426d3bd3800f7c30b7ca9a98d08621/internal/cli/stats_cache.go#L124), decoding one JSON value does not ensure the gzip stream reaches a valid EOF. Removing its eight-byte footer still serves **all 10 cached transcripts**, contradicting the promised corruption fallback. Validate the entire stream before accepting entries.

All three reproduced with focused tests. Existing stats tests and **151/151 status-line checks passed**. Your working tree is unchanged; no review was published.
